questions.prompt: What date did George Washington assign for the 1789 national day of thanksgiving?
questions.explanation: Washington's October 3 proclamation assigned Thursday, November 26, 1789. Thanksgiving did not yet have the fixed annual date used today; the dates varied until Congress set a federal date in 1941.

sources.displayName: U.S. National Archives - Congress Establishes Thanksgiving

questions.prompt: Sputnik's success intensified both the space race and the arms race during the Cold War.
questions.explanation: The U.S. Office of the Historian says the Soviet satellite heightened fears of falling behind and helped drive both space and weapons programs. A scientific first also became a Cold War turning point.

sources.displayName: U.S. Office of the Historian - Sputnik, 1957

questions.prompt: Which song appeared on the B-side of the Beatles' first single, “Love Me Do”?
questions.explanation: “P.S. I Love You” backed “Love Me Do” on the Beatles' debut single, released in the United Kingdom on October 5, 1962. It later appeared on their album Please Please Me.

questions.prompt: What did Mayor and Queloz first detect about the object orbiting 51 Pegasi?

options.text: It circled its star every 4.2 days
It circled its star every 4.2 years
It circled its star once each day
It drifted through space without orbiting a star

questions.explanation: Their measurements revealed an object circling 51 Pegasi in just 4.2 days. The researchers checked the signal before announcing the first confirmed planet found around a Sun-like star.

questions.prompt: Which cities did KLM's 1920 inaugural flight connect as scheduled service began?
questions.explanation: KLM's inaugural flight on May 17, 1920, began its scheduled service between London and Amsterdam. Its later Amsterdam-to-Batavia route reached much farther, but that service began in 1930.

questions.prompt: Who caught the final pitch of Don Larsen's 1956 World Series perfect game?
questions.explanation: Yankees catcher Yogi Berra caught Dale Mitchell's final strike and leapt into Larsen's arms. The Hall of Fame preserves Berra's mitt from the game among its artifacts.

sources.displayName: National Baseball Hall of Fame - Don Larsen defined World Series perfection

questions.prompt: What was the Universal Postal Union called when the 1874 Treaty of Bern established it?
questions.explanation: The Treaty of Bern established the General Postal Union. As membership grew, it adopted the name Universal Postal Union in 1878; the original treaty also created a single territory for exchanging letters across borders.
